finding.typeSuppression: {file}:{line} suppresses type or lint errors; fix the underlying error
finding.emptyCatch: {file}:{line} swallows an exception; handle or propagate it deliberately
finding.skippedTest: {file}:{line} skips or focuses a test; make the suite pass for real
finding.debtMarker: {file}:{line} leaves a TODO/FIXME/HACK marker; finish it or record the debt in PROGRESS.md
finding.fixedSleep: {file}:{line} uses a fixed sleep; wait on a condition or synchronisation primitive
finding.loweredCoverage: {file}:{line} lowers a coverage threshold below 90; write tests instead
finding.nonEnglishCode: {file}:{line} contains non-English text in source code; use English and i18n keys
finding.secretFound: {file}:{line} looks like a secret or credential; remove it and rotate the value
finding.progressStatusInvalid: PROGRESS.md first line must be STATUS: IN_PROGRESS, ALL_MILESTONES_DONE or BLOCKED (found: {first})
finding.progressUpdatedLineMissing: PROGRESS.md lacks the 'Cập nhật:' header line
finding.progressNextStepMissing: PROGRESS.md is IN_PROGRESS but has no 'BƯỚC TIẾP THEO:' line with content
finding.progressDoneWithoutUat: STATUS ALL_MILESTONES_DONE requires UAT-COVERAGE.md with every row PASS
finding.progressBlockerReportIncomplete: STATUS BLOCKED requires a '## Blocker' section with the four numbered parts
finding.commitNotConventional: Commit subject is not a conventional commit: {subject}
finding.commitSubjectTooLong: Commit subject is {length} characters; keep it at 100 or fewer
finding.codexHighFinding: Codex review reported a blocking finding: {line}
finding.codexNoRecommendation: Codex review returned no 'Recommendation:' line; treat as incomplete
stage.protocol-scan: Protocol scan (banned shortcuts, English code, secrets)
report.verdictFail: {count} required gate(s) failed; do not ship
